info.name: SafePay Workflow
info.description: Source-verified SafePay backend workflow, 13 September 2026. Session-cookie authentication, not JWT. Import SafePay Local and read the companion report first. Default: no credentials and all data-mutation opt-ins false. Never export populated credentials, CSRF values or cookie jars. Requires a modern Postman runtime with pm.execution.skipRequest(). Use ONE iteration, no parallel runs. Existing source still uses legacy transaction persistence transitions; no approval/verification HTTP endpoint exists.
